audit.whatIsWrong: The page never said what Wind Wall actually does here — dosFull[1] said only 'her E autos' and report[5] tracked Divine Judgment instead.
audit.why: Kayle's passive (Divine Ascent fire waves), Radiant Blast (Q) and Starfire Spellblade (E) all carry the projectile flag. Wind Wall stands 4s on 25s at rank 1, so one wall deletes essentially her entire damage output for its duration — the single biggest interaction in the lane.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall eats her passive waves, Radiant Blast (Q) and Starfire Spellblade (E); Divine Judgment is untargetability, not a projectile.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 row gave the stage to Yasuo on both layers; the mirror gives it to Kayle.
audit.why: At 6 Kayle gains ranged autos and Divine Judgment, which makes her untargetable through the burst window — your all-in stops being free. Mirror chart: Yasuo, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Yasuo.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and win[4] flipped to Kayle as a matched pair, rating to 4/10, with the why rewritten to the 160s Divine Judgment bait.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level-6 prose said 'she's still fragile, keep diving and don't respect her yet' with no cooldown attached.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s. At rank 1 that is a two-and-a-half minute window after she spends it — the concrete sequencing the page was missing.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text and phases[4].why now name the 160s rank-1 cooldown and tell you to force it out before diving.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal line existed but attributed the healing to nothing and called Kayle 'his'.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing (W) is a 15s heal on herself and the nearest ally — that is what beats chip damage.
audit.corrected: Itemization line now names Celestial Blessing and its 15s cadence.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention of Kayle's auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Starfire Spellblade (E) carries the autoReset flag and scales with missing health — the wind-up animation is the tell to step out, not the cast.

edits.after: Divine Judgment makes her untargetable for the burst — 160s at rank 1, so bait it, then commit Last Breath on the knockup.
